name: task-manager
description: Task Manager — Angular client and Express/JSON API. Root scripts install and run both projects together.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.start: concurrently --names "api,web" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run serve" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.start:single: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run serve
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
